ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Matter delivery, Final billing and later stages need Billing model and Fee estimate.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Opening", 1, "Cleared to start", 2, "In progress", 3, "Awaiting client", 4, "Final billing", 5, "Closed", 6, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_model__c)), ISBLANK(Fee_estimate__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Billing model and Fee estimate before moving to Final billing.
